d: 24-port enterprise access switch with Gigabit Ethernet, PoE support, stackable architecture, high-speed uplinks, advanced security, and centralized management capability.

specs.label: Protocols
specs.value: VLANs, QoS, STP/RSTP, IGMP, SNMP, IPV4 /IPV6, TCP/UDP

specs.label: POE standards
specs.value: IEEE 802.3af (PoE), IEEE 802.3at (PoE+), Cisco UPOE (60W), Cisco UPOE+ (90W)

specs.label: Layer 2 features
specs.value: VLAN, Voice VLAN, STP, RSTP, MSTP, PVST+, Link Aggregation (LACP - IEEE 802.3ad), LLDP / LLDP-MED / CDP, Port mirroring (SPAN)

specs.label: Layer 3 features
specs.value: Static routing, Inter-VLAN routing, IPv4 / IPv6 Dual Stack, OSPF / OSPFv3, EIGRP, BGP, Inter-VLAN Routing, Policy-Based Routing (PBR)

specs.label: Security features
specs.value: 802.1X authentication, MAC authentication bypass, DHCP snooping, Dynamic ARP inspection, IP Source Guard, Access Control Lists (ACLs), Secure Boot & Trust Anchor Module (TAM)

specs.label: Multicast
specs.value: IGMP v1, IGMP v2, IGMP v3, IGMP Snooping, PIM Sparse Mode (PIM-SM), Source-Specific Multicast (SSM)
